subject: Offer decision: seniority anchoring + manager vs IC for Riley Morgan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Candidate packet — Riley Morgan (SWE) — level recommendation request

Hi all,

Attached: resume + initial offer packet draft + our seniority anchoring rubric. Riley (recruiter: Brightlane) finished loop last week — strong backend systems, owned infra migrations at current employer, limited direct reports (peer mentor of 1). Wants to move into a company where she can either continue as a high-impact IC or take a small-manager role.

Quick facts:
- Current title: Senior Software Engineer at Brightlane
- Years exp: 7
- Area: backend / infra / distributed systems
- Interview feedback: 4.4 avg (system design 4.7, leadership 3.8)

Ask: please confirm recommended seniority anchor (L5 IC, L5 manager, or L6) and sanity-check comp we should put in packet. Hiring manager is Vivek — headcount is an open L5 req but can be rocked into a manager req if we choose to convert. HR approval ticket HC-4821 is open but not yet approved for a manager slot.

Notes on timeline: Riley has two other offers; recruiter is asking for our packet by EOD Fri.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Attachments: riley_morgan_resume.pdf, seniority_anchoring_rubric_Q1_2027.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet — Riley Morgan (SWE) — level recommendation request

Thanks Priyom — quick take: I lean toward L5 Senior IC rather than L5 Manager. Riley's systems depth is strong; the leadership rubric scores are borderline for people manager expectations (3.8). We don't have a current opening that includes manager headcount approved in HC-4821; converting to a manager req risks delay and additional headcount approval.

If we anchor at L5 IC we can offer a clear path to engineering manager in 6–12 months with a formal development plan and a commitment to interview for the first open manager slot. That keeps offer timing tight.

For comp sanity-check: use L5 band midpoint as baseline. Recommend: base $195,000 — $210,000 range, equity 0.15%–0.25% (4-year vest, 1yr cliff), sign-on $10k discretionary. Total comp target roughly midpoint $230k–$270k. If Laura says we have discount flexibility for strong match, we can tighten.

Also need Laura's approval on equity band and Marissa to confirm funding (people ops headcount bucket).

— Vivek
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-02T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet — Riley Morgan (SWE) — level recommendation request

Vivek — I reviewed the rubric attachment and Riley's loop notes. HR/comp principles: candidate looks well-aligned with L5 IC competency (deep craft, cross-team impact) but not yet clearly L6 (scope and mentorship breadth). Manager expectations require demonstrated direct people development and performance calibration; we don't have that signal.

Approve recommendation: L5 Senior IC.
Comp guidance: fine to lead with base = $205k and equity = 0.20% for a strong hire case. Approve sign-on up to $15k if needed to beat competing offers. Please add a short PDP (6mo milestones) into the offer packet that describes manager-path criteria.

I will mark comp approval in the HC ticket once Marissa confirms budget.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & Rewards

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-02T14:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet — Riley Morgan (SWE) — level recommendation request

Looping in budget confirmation: we have an open L5 IC headcount in the Q1 hiring plan (code HC-4821) with committed dollars. Approving base $205k + equity 0.20% + sign-on $12k fits within the hiring curve and maintains parity with recent L5 IC offers. If Vivek wants $15k sign-on we'd need a brief justification note (comp retention risk + competing offers) to attach to the HC ticket.

If we were to convert to an L5 manager req, we'd need formal reclassification (will push HC-4821 to HC-4821-MGR) which will take ~5–7 business days to approve and could cause Riley to accept elsewhere. Recommendation: extend L5 IC as Laura suggested and create a tracked manager-development path in the offer.

— Marissa
Director, People Operations

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-03T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet — Riley Morgan (SWE) — level recommendation request

Quick operational notes and suggested wording to avoid future anchor drift:

1) Offer language: "Role: Senior Software Engineer (IC), Level: L5. We commit to a manager-track development plan; candidate will be eligible to apply for open manager roles after 6 months contingent on performance and leadership milestones."
2) PDP: include 3 measurable objectives (ownership of a production migration, mentorship of 2 engineers, lead an architecture review) and a 6-month checkpoint with Vivek.
3) Compensation clause: include discretionary sign-on clause ("up to $15,000") but use $12k in initial packet to keep room for negotiation.

Once you confirm final numbers (Vivek/Laura/Marissa), Priyom — please send the packet and cc HC ticket link.

— Tessa
Head of Recruiting Operations

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Riley Morgan <riley.morgan@example.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-03T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Offer packet (draft) — Riley Morgan — Senior Software Engineer, L5 (IC)

Riley — great speaking earlier. We're excited to move forward. Attached is the draft offer packet. High level: Senior Software Engineer (IC), Level L5; Base: $205,000; Equity: 0.20% (4y vesting, 1y cliff); Sign-on: $12,000 (discretionary up to $15,000); Start date: flexible within 4 weeks.

Per our internal agreement, the offer includes a manager-track PDP with a 6-month checkpoint. If you prefer a manager role we can discuss conversion timing after you join.

Please review and let me know any questions — would like to finalize by EOD Friday to stay competitive with your other timelines.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_packet_draft_RileyM_v1.pdf
